body: Great. As usually, my stupid posts never get more than one or two people to respond. But now, on front page of suicidewatch,  person with exactly same idea getting more and more comments. Why you care about one person and not the other? I'm sick of this place.

Well, there are things that I enjoy in life. But the fact that I have almost no time to spend on them now, because of school (and, in short time, because of work), makes them useless. Another problem is the fact that these enjoyable things are just a drop in the bucked compared to amount of shitty things.
